description: This file is a bundled JavaScript module exporting debugging utilities, including color formatting, logging, and environment detection, used within the Next.js project for debugging purposes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes debugging configuration with provided options.

methods.name: formatArgs
methods.description: Formats log message arguments with color and namespace styling.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves debug configuration to environment variables or local storage.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads debug configuration from environment variables or local storage.

methods.name: useColors
methods.description: Determines if color output should be used based on environment.
